suspect:kessler_vane: Kessler Vane leaned against the server rack with his interface port uncovered. His neural log showed a three-hour gap where the timestamps should be.
event:memory_wipe_exploit: A targeted memory wipe erased Tanaka's last forty-eight hours of neural storage. The exploit required root access and knowledge of the implant firmware.
motive:surveillance_backdoor: Tanaka discovered a backdoor routing civilian surveillance data to a private buyer. The code signature matched a contract Vane had brokered six months earlier.
suspect:rina_cade: Rina Cade ran the neural calibration lab and had access to every implant in the district. Her visor was cracked across the left lens.
suspect:marshal_cross: Marshal Cross maintained the cooling systems and carried a master access badge. His shift log showed continuous entries except for fourteen minutes.
suspect:juno_park: Juno Park specialised in data recovery and had visited the vault six times that month. She said she was running standard integrity checks.
suspect:dex_millard: Dex Millard sold black-market firmware upgrades in the neon market. His visor was found on the transit corridor floor after the blackout.
suspect:overseer_lang: Overseer Lang controlled the power grid allocation for the district. His authorisation was required for any planned outage.
suspect:ada_strand: Ada Strand worked as a contract analyst with clearance for the surveillance feeds. Her encrypted personal chip contained files she claimed were research notes.
location:server_farm: The server farm occupies four sublevels beneath the transit hub. The cooling fans run constantly and the air tastes of ozone.
location:neural_lab: The neural lab is a clean room on sublevel two with biometric locks. Tanaka was found slumped at her calibration station with her port still open.
location:transit_corridor: The transit corridor connects the server farm to the surface levels. The overhead lights cycle off during grid resets.
location:command_deck: The command deck monitors power distribution across the district. Twelve screens display real-time grid status and access logs.
location:data_vault: The data vault stores archived surveillance feeds behind a triple-lock system. The humidity is controlled and the walls are signal-shielded.
location:cooling_bay: The cooling bay circulates fluid through the server racks at constant pressure. A stain on the floor near rack seven has not been cleaned.
location:neon_market: The neon market runs along the surface concourse under flickering signs. Rain drips through the ventilation gaps and pools on the grating.
location:private_node: The private node is an unregistered terminal behind a false panel in the cooling bay. The connection bypasses all standard monitoring.
object:neural_implant: Tanaka's neural implant was removed post-mortem and its firmware partially overwritten. The remaining code contains fragments of an unauthorised exploit.
object:access_log: The server farm access log records all badge swipes by time and level. One entry at 02:17 uses a cloned credential that does not match any staff member.
object:wipe_residue: Residual charge patterns on Tanaka's implant are consistent with a forced memory purge. The wipe was thorough but left artefacts in the boot sector.
object:backdoor_code: A code fragment recovered from the private node matches the surveillance routing exploit. The compiler signature links to Vane's registered development environment.
object:biometric_scan: The biometric scanner at the neural lab door recorded six entries between midnight and four. One scan returned a confidence score below normal threshold.
object:data_fragment: A recovered data fragment contains routing instructions for civilian surveillance feeds. The destination address is a private server registered under a shell company.
object:cooling_fluid: Cooling fluid from rack seven shows an unusual pH level. The imbalance is consistent with a foreign substance introduced through the circulation port.
object:encrypted_chip: Ada Strand's personal chip is encrypted with a military-grade algorithm. Partial decryption reveals surveillance metadata timestamped to the night of the death.
object:broken_visor: A cracked AR visor was found near the neural lab entrance. The display memory contains the last image rendered: a grid map of sublevel two.
object:power_grid_log: The power grid log shows a scheduled reset at 02:00 followed by an unscheduled spike at 02:14. The spike duration matches the exploit execution window.
object:surveillance_feed: Archived surveillance feeds for sublevel two show a four-minute loop between 02:10 and 02:14. The loop replaces live footage with a pre-recorded segment.
object:comm_transcript: A communication transcript recovered from the command deck shows an encrypted exchange at 01:55. The encryption key has not been cracked.
object:signal_trace: A signal trace from the private node shows data transmitted to an external address at 02:16. The packet size matches a full neural memory dump.
emotion:flat_affect: His voice did not modulate when shown the implant. He asked whether the firmware version had been logged.
emotion:quick_deflection: She redirected every question about the lab to the access protocols. Her hand moved to her cracked visor and stopped.
emotion:coded_language: Each response used technical jargon that obscured more than it clarified. She spoke as if giving testimony she had rehearsed.
emotion:micro_delay: There was a half-second pause before each answer about the cooling bay. His eyes tracked right before he spoke.
emotion:hollow_calm: Her tone was perfectly level throughout the interview. She did not blink when the encrypted chip was placed on the table.
emotion:forced_cooperation: He offered to open his grid logs without being asked. His hand was already on the terminal before the question was finished.
modifier:log_overwritten: The access log entry at 02:17 was overwritten with null data within six minutes. The overwrite used administrative privileges.
modifier:power_spike: The unscheduled power spike at 02:14 lasted eleven seconds. The spike profile matches a forced neural purge at maximum voltage.
modifier:signal_masked: The communication at 01:55 used frequency-hopping encryption. The signal was routed through three relay nodes to obscure its origin.
modifier:rain_static: Rain interference degraded external communications after midnight. The transit corridor cameras recorded only static during the outage window.
modifier:node_isolated: The private node was disconnected from the main network but retained a direct external uplink. The isolation was deliberate.
modifier:implant_signature: The exploit code on Tanaka's implant carries a compiler signature registered to Vane's development licence. The signature is unique to his toolchain.
modifier:coolant_stain: The coolant stain near rack seven contains traces of neural conducting gel. The gel is used only in implant calibration procedures.
modifier:visor_crack_pattern: The crack pattern on the visor radiates from a single impact point. The force is consistent with the visor being dropped, not struck.
modifier:code_remnant: A code remnant in the implant boot sector references the surveillance backdoor by its internal project name. The name appears in no public documentation.
modifier:port_scorched: The neural port housing shows micro-scorching consistent with a high-voltage forced connection. The burn pattern is directional.
action:exploit_deployed: The memory wipe exploit was deployed via direct port connection at approximately 02:12. The execution required physical access to the implant interface.
action:power_cut_staged: The power grid was reset at 02:00 to create a maintenance window. The reset masked the subsequent spike caused by the exploit.
action:vault_breached: The data vault was accessed during the blackout using cloned credentials. The triple-lock system recorded no anomaly because the clone matched at all three levels.
action:feed_looped: The surveillance feed for sublevel two was replaced with a four-minute loop. The loop was spliced from footage recorded the previous night.
action:scan_forged: A biometric scan was forged using a captured template from the access system. The confidence score was low but passed the minimum threshold.
action:chip_planted: An encrypted chip was planted in Ada Strand's personal storage without her knowledge. The chip contained surveillance metadata designed to implicate her.
action:visor_removed: A visor was dropped near the neural lab entrance during the blackout. The owner has not come forward to claim it.
action:signal_rerouted: Surveillance data was rerouted from the main archive to an external server. The rerouting occurred automatically via the backdoor code.
action:node_accessed: The private node behind the cooling bay panel was accessed between 01:50 and 02:20. The connection log shows a single session.
time:blackout_hour: The scheduled grid reset began at 02:00 and lasted twelve minutes. During this window all internal cameras and sensors were offline.
time:grid_cycle: The grid cycles through maintenance every seventy-two hours. The reset on the night of the death coincided with the standard schedule.
time:body_located: Tanaka's body was found by the maintenance bot at 06:14. The implant port was open and the calibration station was powered down.
time:access_window: The cloned credential was used between 02:10 and 02:24. No other unauthorised access was recorded in that period.
time:audit_pending: A security audit of the surveillance system was scheduled for the following week. Tanaka had flagged anomalies in the routing tables.
motive:contract_profit: Vane brokered a contract to sell surveillance access to a private intelligence firm. The contract was worth three years of his standard salary.
motive:corporate_espionage: Juno Park had been contracted by a competing firm to extract archived surveillance data. Her visits to the vault coincided with data export events.
motive:exposure_panic: Tanaka's audit would have revealed the backdoor within days. Vane had no way to remove the code without leaving a trace.
motive:rival_network: Overseer Lang was building an independent power brokerage using grid access as leverage. Tanaka's audit threatened to expose his side operations.
motive:data_ransom: Ada Strand had been approached to sell decrypted surveillance feeds on the black market. The value of a single feed exceeded her annual contract.
witness:grid_operator: The grid operator confirmed the scheduled reset at 02:00. She noted the unscheduled spike at 02:14 but attributed it to a cooling fault.
witness:courier_drone: A courier drone transiting the corridor at 01:58 recorded thermal signatures of two individuals near the neural lab entrance.
witness:maintenance_bot: The maintenance bot found Tanaka at 06:14 during its standard sweep. Its log shows no other anomalies on sublevel two.
witness:shift_analyst: The shift analyst reviewed the access log at 07:00 and flagged the cloned credential entry. She escalated it to security within the hour.
witness:vendor_ai: A vendor AI in the neon market recorded a signal burst at 02:16 consistent with a large data transmission. The source was below street level.
event:yuki_tanaka_discovered: Yuki Tanaka was found at her calibration station on sublevel two. Her neural port was open and her implant had been partially wiped.
event:grid_surge: An unscheduled power surge hit sublevel two at 02:14. The surge was contained to the neural lab circuit and lasted eleven seconds.
